english_text: Opposing me is nothing short of madness!
czech_text: Postavit se mi je čiré šílenství!

english_text: Good of you to rejoin us.
czech_text: Jak milé, že jste se vrátili.

english_text: I will not accept defeat! Fight!
No! It cannot end like this!
The world will never know you existed!
czech_text: Svět se nikdy nedozví, že jste existovali!

english_text: Do not lose the advantage now!
I am not renowned for my patience!
Our warriors have found their courage!
Bring me victory! Die if you must!
czech_text: Přineste mi vítězství! Zemřete, je-li třeba!

english_text: Our men flee, like whipped curs!
czech_text: Naši muži prchají jako zbití psi!

english_text: I risk all, and I take all.
czech_text: Riskuji vše a beru si vše.

english_text: We are not yet out of options!
Who is responsible for this defeat?
czech_text: Kdo je za tuto porážku zodpovědný?

english_text: Take the foe's base, or wipe them out!
czech_text: Dobuďte jejich základnu, nebo je vyhlaďte!

english_text: The victor of Marathon is dead!

czech_text: Vy si říkáte válečníci? Vraťte se!

english_text: We made an end of Scipio!
The men show some spine! And have rallied!
czech_text: Muži přece jen mají kuráž! Znovu se řadí!

english_text: Our countermeasures have caught our allies!
Those who resist me will suffer.
czech_text: Kdo se mi vzepře, bude trpět.

english_text: The only good Greek is an impaled Greek.
czech_text: Dobrý Řek je jen Řek na kůlu.

english_text: Cease fire! We're attacking our allies!
We've been hurt by our allies' countermeasures!
Perhaps some wine and dates while we wait?
czech_text: Snad trochu vína a datlí, zatímco čekáme?

english_text: I will crush all who oppose me!
czech_text: Rozdrtím každého, kdo se mi postaví!

english_text: Capture their base! Or kill the lot of them!
czech_text: Dobuďte jejich základnu! Nebo je všechny pobijte!

english_text: The enemy general has been slain!
How could we let our base fall?
czech_text: Jak jsme mohli dopustit pád základny?

english_text: The enemy base is about to fall!
If you lose, I'll kill you myself!
The Roman Titan Sulla is dead!
If we lose, heads will roll!
Defend the base! Now, you fools!
Our allies' countermeasures have caught us!
We lost! How can that be?!
czech_text: Prohráli jsme! Jak je to možné?!

english_text: Annihilate them, or take their base!
czech_text: Zničte je, nebo dobuďte jejich základnu!

english_text: We are firing on our allies!
Their base will soon be ours!
Get to our base! It is being attacked!
I will have victory, by whatever means!
Boudica is out of the fight!
Do they not know who I am?
Stop! We are firing on Allied troops!
